string.text: Default lets NVIDIA choose the model. J/K/L/M are explicit NGX presets; availability and results depend on the GPU and DLSS runtime. Applies after renderer restart. Does not affect FSR.

Native DX11 integration adapted from brodrigz. FSR 3.1.2 is built into the engine and needs feature level 11.1; DLSS needs RTX and nvngx_dlss.dll. Main-view reconstruction is separate from PiP; frame generation is not included.
